product_rule: Wedding Song Promo uses Forever & A Day only. Wedding Pack may offer multiple approved KUT choices cut from this one source.
warning: These are draft v2 phrase-complete candidate cuts. They must pass human listening review before upload, launch seeding, checkout, or fulfillment.

v1_review.reason: dry mechanical cuts did not fulfill sound and/or left out resolving end lines
v1_review.control_action: do not upload or seed v1 cuts

processing_rule.rule: Preserve complete musical/lyric thought first. Padding/fade polish second. Page Twinkle belongs in delivery UI until an approved audio Twinkle asset exists.

review_checklist: title matches what the user hears
option feels complete enough to send

kuts.buyer_intent: A gentle opening wedding moment that introduces the promise.
kuts.review_note: Must include opening forever motif and enough of the first verse to feel like an intentional sendable moment.

kuts.buyer_intent: A direct romantic chorus option centered on the title promise.
kuts.review_note: Must include the full chorus and resolving forever-and-a-day payoff.

kuts.buyer_intent: A fuller short-form option with setup plus the first chorus payoff.
kuts.review_note: Must not stop before the chorus lands emotionally.

kuts.buyer_intent: A reflective wedding option about history, memory, and where love is going.
kuts.review_note: Must include second verse and enough following resolution to avoid sounding unfinished.

kuts.buyer_intent: A committed-love option built around staying together through stumbles and falls.
kuts.review_note: Must include the bridge line and full final chorus payoff.

kuts.buyer_intent: A strong closing hook for a wedding send.
kuts.review_note: Must carry through final forever-and-a-day line, not fade before the title phrase resolves.

kuts.buyer_intent: The fullest closing wedding KUT candidate, carrying through the ending.
kuts.review_note: Must keep enough tail to feel complete and premium.
